rule: A station of this line is not kept by type or operator (rules 2 and 3 of metrics_oc.confirm_rail_stations): the operator publishes the line in its GTFS when it runs, and its current schedule has no such route. A GTFS rail stop within 400 m would still confirm the station.

evidence.note: JTA's current GTFS (MobilityData copy, sha256 c41a1f106be1d742..., read 8 Nov 2026): the schedule effective 2 Nov 2026. Its routes.txt has 40 routes, all route_type 3 (bus); none is the Skyway.

JTA's 2023 GTFS (MobilityData legacy mirror, calendar 23 Jan - 3 Sep 2023, sha256 a19abb8cca27f6b3..., read 8 Nov 2026): when the Skyway ran, JTA's feed listed it (route 605, route_type 1) with a stop at the JRTC's LaVilla platform, 9 m from OpenStreetMap's station node.

leads_not_opened: Search-engine excerpts (the pages themselves are refused by this machine's network policy, so they are leads, not evidence): JTA's site banner 'Skyway Service Update: Due to unexpected operational circumstances, the Skyway service has concluded early today, October 30.' (jtafla.com/rider-guide); News4JAX, 17 Sep 2026: 'The JTA plans to suspend passenger operations on the Skyway beginning Nov. 2'. OpenStreetMap already tags the line's other seven stations disused.
